events.title: Theodosius I settles the Goths inside the Roman Empire
events.description: Emperor Theodosius I concluded a treaty allowing the Goths to settle south of the Danube as semi-autonomous allies. Giving a whole people land within the frontier set a precedent that reshaped the late Roman world.
events.html: Emperor Theodosius I concluded a treaty allowing the Goths to settle south of the Danube as semi-autonomous allies. Giving a whole people land within the frontier set a precedent that reshaped the late Roman world.

events.title: Francis of Assisi dies at the Porziuncola
events.description: Francis of Assisi died at the Porziuncola chapel below Assisi. The merchant's son who embraced radical poverty had founded the Franciscan order, and he was canonised less than two years later.
events.html: Francis of Assisi died at the Porziuncola chapel below Assisi. The merchant's son who embraced radical poverty had founded the Franciscan order, and he was canonised less than two years later.

events.title: Lincoln proclaims a national day of Thanksgiving
events.description: Amid the Civil War, Abraham Lincoln proclaimed the last Thursday of November a national day of thanksgiving. The proclamation answered years of campaigning by the editor Sarah Josepha Hale and began an annual federal holiday.
events.html: Amid the Civil War, Abraham Lincoln proclaimed the last Thursday of November a national day of thanksgiving. The proclamation answered years of campaigning by the editor Sarah Josepha Hale and began an annual federal holiday.

events.title: King Alexander renames his realm the Kingdom of Yugoslavia
events.description: Alexander I renamed the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes as Yugoslavia, 'land of the South Slavs', as part of his royal dictatorship. The new name was meant to override the national rivalries dividing the state.

events.title: Germany is reunified
events.description: The German Democratic Republic acceded to the Federal Republic, reuniting Germany 45 years after its division. The peaceful merger, less than a year after the Berlin Wall opened, marked the close of the Cold War in Europe.
